# Immich artwork

The source flower is copyright Immich contributors, distributed under AGPL-3.0 in the upstream repository.

Source: https://github.com/immich-app/immich/blob/166e93559f123313cf9cb4e7324c4ee30e21c618/design/immich-logo.svg
License: [LICENSE](LICENSE). Imported text uses LF line endings; artwork paths and license wording are unchanged.

SAO's adaptation preserves the original five path shapes and colors, scales them onto a light tile, and adds an insert/overlay badge. Its monochrome variant uses the same flower silhouette. These icons identify an independent SAO source extension; they do not imply endorsement by Immich. The source vectors and modifications are published in this repository.
